Group transportation in Scottsdale

Group transportation in Scottsdale is chauffeured, driver included: corporate teams, conference shuttles, wedding guest shuttles and nights out ride together in one vehicle sized to the group. For 1 to 14 guests that is the Luxury SUV (Suburban), up to 6, or an Executive Sprinter, up to 14; for 15 to 28, the Mini Bus (24 Pax) or Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) for corporate groups and shuttles, or the Party Bus (28 Pax) for a party or bachelorette night; for 29 to 56, the 56-Passenger Motorcoach. Booking is by the hour: choose the vehicle and the hours, see the total before you pay, then reserve online or call us.
